text:
incident-bot: PAGER: runtime-prod (us-west-2) latency SLO breach on /v1/generate. Spike at the 99th/95th tail, elevated kernel_fallback and request_timeouts. Started ~10:12 UTC.

mike_sre: I'm on it — pulling canary + prod metrics now.

mike_sre: quick check: canary error rate + sawtooth on batching window and kernel_fallback > 0.7 on hot pool.

devops-bot: canary-12 health: error_rate +12%, kernel_fallback_ratio=0.82, kv_cache_hit_down=true.

carla_eng: confirming logs — prefetch_v2 path showing serialization delay, batches building much larger than expected. KV hit drop correlates.

mike_sre: rollout id 5067798000 (feature flag: prefetched-path/prefetch_v2) promoted ~15m before alert.

joni_oncall: taking primary for the incident window. Handing off to me for next hour if needed.

mike_sre: recommendation: toggle kill-switch for prefetched-path (revert to legacy path) to stop kernel fallback cascade. Any objections?

tara_prod: support seeing customer retries/timeouts. approve kill-switch. Notify customers afterwards.

mike_sre: toggling kill-switch now :wrench:

devops-bot: featureflag.update: prefetched-path = false (actor: mike_sre, rollout: immediate)

incident-bot: AUTO: rollback hook engaged for rollout 5067798000. Routing shifted to legacy kernel on affected nodes.

emma_support: quick impact estimate: ~1.8% of requests returned 5xx or timed out in last 15m. Top reported customers: AcmeAnalytics, NovaPay. Support ticket created and customers contacted via standard incident template.

mike_sre: applying short-term mitigation: reduce batch_window to 16ms on hot pool and force kv-cache warmup.

carla_eng: config snippet I applied:
```
# hot-pool overrides
batch_window_ms: 16
kv_prefetch: false
```

mike_sre: metrics update — kernel_fallback trending down, 95th latency dropping toward SLO. Continuing watch.

devops-bot: rollback completed for rollout 5067798000 (status: success). Canary traffic scaled back.

joni_oncall: I'll monitor dashboards and paging for 30m, escalate if error rate > 1% again.

tara_prod: posted initial incident notice to customers + status page, linked incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/5067809123 (internal).

mike_sre: next steps: reproduce locally in staging, add regression test for prefetch+batching kernel selection, and add auto-guard in rollout pipeline to detect kernel_fallback spikes.

emma_support: support ticket #7892 opened, customers informed, will update with postmortem.

carla_eng: adding to release checklist: run kernel-selection stress test + verify kv-cache hit rate before promote.

joni_oncall: thanks all — keeping channel open for postmortem notes. Please @me if you add follow-ups. :thumbsup:

mike_sre: closing active mitigation — marking incident as stabilized. Will coordinate postmortem and timeline tomorrow.
